{{Quote|Do you know who I am? I am Lieutenant Weeznod - the twenty-third highest ranking officer in all of House Organa!|Weeznod|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Weeznod''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] of the [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. After a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] was stolen by [[House of Thul|House Thul]] agents, he requested a Republic citizen to help infiltrate the Marketplace Villa in [[King's Pass]] and retrieve the stolen holocron before House Thul could deliver it to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. His contact was successful in retrieving the holocron and delivered it to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Dolso]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
